title: Supply Chain & Procurement Assistant (Tamheer Opportunity)
description: Official Siemens Tamheer opportunity in Jeddah for a recent college graduate in supply chain management. The role assists with supply-chain strategies, guidelines, and operating procedures; supports governance and functional-excellence methods and tools; handles procurement execution and internal ordering procedures; and contributes to supply-chain data and quality-report analysis. The listing is full-time, fixed-term, and office/site based.
